seo.title: Flights | TripAgent
seo.description: Fares in every cabin, business and first our care: held, ticketed and watched by an advisor who knows you.

hero.headingHtml:
The front of the aircraft
is our home.
hero.lede: Business and first are where we are happiest. We book every cabin. And we see what you can’t: held premium fares, award space, the routing that saves the connection.

pullq.quoteHtml:
Anyone can sell a seat.
We find the right one.
pullq.lede: A ticket is easy. The right ticket: the flat-bed that lies flat, the fare that stays refundable, the connection that holds, comes from someone who does this every day and knows how you travel.

idx.heading: Every part of it, and the parts you never see.
idx.lede: Six things, handled end to end. Most agents stop at the first.

rows.heading: Every airline & alliance
rows.body: Every carrier, every alliance, every cabin from economy to first: chosen for you, never handed over as a list.

rows.heading: Business & first: our particular care
rows.body: We know the front of the aircraft: the right suite, the real flat-bed with direct aisle access, the fare that makes sense.

rows.heading: Fares held while you decide
rows.body: We hold the price and the seats together while you think. Nothing slips away between a coffee and a decision.

rows.heading: Seats, meals & lounges
rows.body: The seat that suits you, the meal you prefer, lounge access before you land: the small things that make the hours pass well.

rows.heading: Miles, upgrades & status
rows.body: We put your miles and status to work, and find upgrade and award space you wouldn’t see yourself, timed to clear.

rows.heading: Changes & refunds, handled
rows.body: Plans move. Your advisor reworks it: no queue, no hold music, no credit quietly lost.

feat.headingHtml:
Where most see a price,
we see a cabin.
feat.lede: This is where the difference is felt, and where the traps hide. A “business” seat can be a suite with a door and a flat-bed you stretch out in, or an angled recliner in a 2-2-2 row with a stranger at your elbow. Same name; different night. We know which is which on every aircraft a route flies.
items: A true flat-bed with direct aisle access, not an angled recliner sold as “business”.
The newer cabin when two aircraft fly a route, so the seat matches the fare.
Award and upgrade space others can’t see: paired with your miles or status to clear it.

signature.lineHtml:
The test is 2 a.m.,
not the booking.
signature.sub: A cancelled flight in a city you don’t know is the real moment. Because we already hold your details and onward plans, the rebooking is done before you’ve fully woken: same cabin, next flight, a message already waiting. No queue. No hold music. We stay with you for the flight, not just the sale.

examples.heading: What “the right seat” looks like.
examples.lede: Three routes our members fly often, and the call we’d make on each.

tiles.label: Delhi → London
tiles.heading: Business, overnight
tiles.body: A nine-hour redeye earns its flat-bed. We find a 1-2-1 cabin with direct aisle access and a forward seat, and time the upgrade or award window so you land rested.

tiles.label: Mumbai → New York
tiles.heading: First, or the right business
tiles.body: Sixteen hours rewards first class where it is genuinely a suite. Where it isn’t, we say so, and put you in the best business cabin rather than pay first-class money for a wider seat.

tiles.label: Bengaluru → Singapore
tiles.heading: Business, daytime
tiles.body: A short daytime hop rarely justifies a flat-bed. We’ll place you in a strong regional business cabin, hold a fare that earns status, and save the premium for flights that warrant it.

howItWorks.heading: From a line of text to a boarding pass.
howItWorks.lede: It begins the same way every time: one message on WhatsApp. Your advisor takes it from there.

steps.heading: Tell us the trip
steps.body: One line on WhatsApp, where, when, who, and how you like to fly.

steps.heading: See a few good fares
steps.body: Two or three considered options, never a wall of results. Sell prices only.

steps.heading: We hold & confirm
steps.body: Your advisor holds the fare and seats, confirms the detail, and tickets it.

steps.heading: We stay, in the air too
steps.body: Changes, delays, disruption: handled as they happen, until you are home.

items.summary: Are there hidden markups on fares?
items.bodyHtml: No. You see the sell price, with taxes and surcharges shown plainly. Where a service fee applies, it is named and agreed before you confirm: never folded into the fare. The economics are stated, because trust is the whole point.

items.summary: Do you only book business and first class?
items.bodyHtml: The front of the aircraft is our specialty, but we book every cabin: economy and premium economy included. And we tell you when a premium cabin is worth it and when it is not. A short daytime hop rarely justifies first; a fourteen-hour overnight almost always does.

items.summary: Can I use my miles and points?
items.bodyHtml: Yes, and we get more from them than self-service does. We know which programmes release the best award space, when to redeem and when to hold, and how to combine points with cash so you spend the right currency on each leg. If a redemption is poor value, we say so rather than burn your miles.

items.summary: How do upgrades and award space actually work?
items.bodyHtml: Upgrade and award inventory is rarely visible on public sites, and what shows there is often stale. We see live premium-cabin availability across carriers, watch for space to open after booking, and time the request: with your status, miles, or a paid instrument, to the moment it is most likely to clear. Nothing is left to the gate.

items.summary: What happens when plans change or I need to cancel?
items.bodyHtml: You send one message; your advisor handles the rest. We know each fare’s change and refund rules before you book, and choose them with your flexibility in mind. When something moves, we rework the ticket without the queue or the hold music, and make sure no penalty, refund or credit is quietly missed.

items.summary: What if my flight is cancelled overnight in a city I don’t know?
items.bodyHtml: That is the real test, and the one we are built for. Because we already hold your full itinerary and onward plans, your advisor rebooks you: usually before the airline’s own queue has moved, same cabin, next sensible flight, and re-sequences your hotels and transfers to match. Often the fix is waiting before you’ve fully woken.

items.summary: Which airlines and routings do you actually recommend?
items.bodyHtml: We are tied to no carrier or alliance, so the advice is yours. We weigh the cabin that is truly flat against the one that only claims to be, the routing that protects your connection, and the fare that earns status rather than dead-ends it. The cheapest seat and the right seat are seldom the same.

items.summary: Can you handle family, group and multi-city travel?
items.bodyHtml: Yes. Families seated together, a group on one record, a multi-city itinerary that holds across several carriers: this is where careful hands matter most. We keep everyone on aligned timings, manage the seat map deliberately, and make sure one change does not unravel the whole journey.

items.summary: What about baggage, special meals and other requests?
items.bodyHtml: Baggage allowances, extra pieces, sporting and musical equipment, dietary and medical meals, wheelchair and mobility assistance, bassinets, unaccompanied minors: all noted with your booking and confirmed with the airline in advance, so they are arranged rather than improvised at the desk.

items.summary: Do you handle corporate and business travel?
items.bodyHtml: We do. We respect company travel policy where it applies, keep documentation clean for expense and reconciliation, and look after what business travellers value most: protected connections, lounge access, and a quiet fix when a meeting moves. The discretion of a private advisor, on a working schedule.

items.summary: How is my data and privacy handled?
items.bodyHtml: Your passport, payment and travel details are held only to arrange your travel, shared with airlines and partners strictly as a booking requires, and never sold. Your advisor is bound to discretion. The detail is in our privacy policy.
Flights are one of three things we do completely: alongside hotels and visas, sequenced into one trip.

cta.headingHtml:
Your next flight: looked after
until you are home.
cta.lede: A private travel maison, by invitation. If you hold one, a seat at the front is already kept for you.
